Enabled.Name: Report gig outcomes to Night City Investments
Enabled.Hint: When a gig is marked completed or failed in Night City Map, tell Night City Investments so the client's share price can react. Turn off to stop reporting without disabling the module.

Pins.Name: Show player businesses on the map
Pins.Hint: Each open business in Night City Investments gets a pin in its district, showing its name, kind, stage and location, and nothing else. Players' businesses go in a Player businesses category and NPCs' companies in NPC companies. Move, edit, hide or delete a pin as you like: your changes stay.

Owners.Name: Name the owners of player businesses on their pins
Owners.Hint: A player business's pin lists who runs it in Night City Map's "who lives here", with portraits for names that match an actor: its partners with a vote, or a company's officers. Never a hidden holder or a silent partner. NPCs' companies are left out.

Warn.NoInvestments: Night City Investments is not active, so gig outcomes cannot be reported.
Warn.OldInvestments: This version of Night City Investments cannot receive gig outcomes. Update it to version 0.6.0 or later.
Warn.NoMap: Night City Map is not active, so there are no gigs to watch.
